name: torpid-fractal-enter-rest-stay-frozen
notes:
REPLACES an earlier version of this fixture (from the parallel Diao Chan batch-fractals work) that was a confirmed silent fake-pass: it only advanced play to the START of player 2's first turn, at which point GetTurnPlayer()==2 but GetTurnNumber() is STILL 1 -- EndPhase() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~line 666-669) only increments TurnNumber when turnPlayer wraps back around to the first player, so 'Turn 1' spans BOTH players' opening turns. WakeUpPhase()'s own guard, 'if($currentTurn === 1) return;' (Custom/GameLogic.php ~line 8088-8089), therefore skips wake-up processing for player 2's first turn too, regardless of Torpid Fractal. Independently verified by instrumenting WakeUpPhase() and the FROZEN_BY_TORPID check block with file_put_contents log lines: the log inside the FROZEN_BY_TORPID branch never fired under the old action sequence, and forcing the opponent-Torpid-Fractal detection loop to always return false still left the old fixture passing -- proof the assertion 'ally stays rested' was true for a reason entirely unrelated to Torpid Fractal (nothing ever attempts to wake anyone during TurnNumber 1).

Fixed by extending the action sequence a full extra round: P1 plays Torpid Fractal targeting the opponent's Dungeon Guide, P1 ends turn 1, P2 ends their turn 1 (TurnNumber still 1, WU no-ops for both, as before), then P1 must explicitly decline their own turn-2 MAT-phase materialize offer (mode 100, cardID 'PASS' -- the mid-turn 'myHealth' Pass button refuses while a MZMAYCHOOSE decision is pending, confirmed empirically the same way samaritan-reach-attacking-ally-damage and swift-recruit-intercept-redirect document) before ending turn 2. Only then does turnPlayer wrap back to player 1, incrementing TurnNumber to 2, and the FOLLOWING wake-up phase (still queued for right after MAIN->BEND->BEOP->END->WU) is player 2's own, with TurnNumber=2 -- genuinely NOT early-returned. Re-instrumented and confirmed the FROZEN_BY_TORPID check log line now fires with currentTurn=2, turnPlayer=2. Re-broke the same detection loop (force $oppHasTorpid=false unconditionally) and confirmed the fixture NOW correctly fails (Dungeon Guide wakes to Status=2, TurnEffects clears to []); restored byte-for-byte via a pre-edit backup diff and confirmed it passes again.

Torpid Fractal (h9u9584zpn, PHANTASIA/CLERIC, element WATER) is played from hand; the champion is patched with CardID=00xbh8oc00 (Diao Chan, Enchantress) + Subcards=[tafqldAGRF] (Spirit of Water) for WATER element access. Paying its 4-reserve cost fires enterAbilities['h9u9584zpn:0'] (GeneratedMacroCode.php), restricting legal targets to allies with ObjectCurrentPower() <= 2; a Dungeon Guide ALLY (1 printed POWER) seeded awake on the opponent's field is the target. customDQHandlers['h9u9584zpn:0:Enter-1'] rests it (ExhaustCard) and tags it with the persistent 'FROZEN_BY_TORPID' TurnEffect ($persistentTurnEffects, Custom/GameLogic.php:18138). The wake-up-phase loop (Custom/GameLogic.php ~8127-8140) checks FROZEN_BY_TORPID and, as long as an opponent (relative to the frozen ally's controller) still controls a real h9u9584zpn, skips waking it.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Rest target ally with 2 POWER or less. That ally doesn't wake up during its controller's wake up phase as long as you control CARDNAME.
